findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted and then shown as "0 L"
findings.expected: An amount below the field's 0.1 L minimum is refused, or it is shown as a non-zero amount
findings.actual: 0.004 L is saved and the confirmation reads "Recorded 0 L on 11 Nov 2026.". The waterings list also shows "0 L" for it
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 11 Nov 2026."]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 11 Nov 2026."]}

findings.title: Waterings page crashes on a malformed list response and stays on "Loading waterings…"
findings.expected: A visible error, no uncaught exception, and the loading text cleared
findings.actual: Uncaught "waterings.value?.reduce is not a function". The status stays on "Loading waterings…" and the old rows (or blank "Never" rows) stay visible

findings.title: Hung filter request leaves other beds' waterings under the chosen bed filter, loading forever
findings.expected: After choosing Shade corner, only its waterings show, or a loading or timeout state replaces the old list
findings.actual: After 13 s the filter still says Shade corner and the page says "Loading waterings…", but the table still lists the North bed waterings from the unfiltered list

findings.title: Past watering accepts a date in year 1
findings.expected: A date such as 0001-01-01 is refused as implausible
findings.actual: It is saved and confirmed as "Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1.", and it shows in the waterings log as "1 Jan 1"
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1."]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1."]}
